posts.en:
InfiniteDSH is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8bec39e5bad57eddacd0.html
